name: 配对模态记录对齐 QC
description: 读取批准 JSON：schema_version=1.0、sources数组(id/independence_group)、records数组(1至128项)。记录必填id/pair_id/modality/source_id/context/time_hours/independent_unit/replicate/quantity/entity/contrast_id/feature/unit/value/reference_value，未知值写null。模态与量为transcript:rna_abundance、protein:protein_abundance、occupancy:target_occupancy、activity:proximal_activity、morphology:morphology_feature。严格按上下文、时间、独立单元、replicate、entity与contrast配对。占有及形态仅参与QC；其余相反方向只产生保留各量标签的待复核候选，不假定不同量应同向。拒绝额外字段和不匹配量，不生成embedding、活性预测或实测证据。 Optional visibility={stage,available_record_ids,acquisition_cost,cost_unit}: stage is pre_experiment, post_acquisition or retrospective. Only explicitly available records enter analysis and output. Omitted visibility means retrospective QC only, acquisition cost unknown. Availability and costs are caller declarations, not verified measurements. Optional record.batch_id records experimental batch. Known unequal batches suppress directional candidates; missing batch is reported as unknown. No batch correction is performed. Also accepts modality chromatin with quantity chromatin_accessibility; accessibility is not a causal regulatory edge.
use_when: 已有配对transcript/protein/activity/morphology标量记录，且来源、上下文、时间和独立单元显式声明，需要对齐质量检查或不一致候选。
do_not_use_when: 需要读取原始图像、预测embedding、跨上下文合并、补全缺失模态、把形态解释为活性，或把同一独立单元的多模态当独立复现。
